implementation_findings: CounterRules._put_counters currently combines replacement planning and the final put_counters_batch commit. Split out a reusable pure placement plan before introducing a transfer transaction; do not remove counters before a replacement choice can suspend.

RulesState has atomic placements and fixed activation counter costs, but no general removal/transfer transaction. Validate every source, recipient, kind and amount before applying source removals and destination placements once.

CounterRange.kind is currently a fixed string. Aven Courier needs an explicit serialized chosen-counter-kind binding, with legal options derived at resolution and its target's existing kind checked then.

Retain separate semantics for copying a departing object's last-known counters (The Ozolith and Essence Channeler death trigger) and actually moving current counters (The Ozolith combat trigger and Forgotten Ancient). Do not follow a stale reference into the new graveyard incarnation.

Extend current per-turn history carefully for life lost, including damage and life payments, and preserve it through checkpoints. Current life total alone cannot establish that life was lost this turn.
